messages:
maya: Hey infra team — short notice: we need GPU quota increases in two new AWS accounts for Dedicated pools. Planned start: 2026-04-05.

Accounts and asks:
- 111122223333 (eu-west-4): p5 instances: current 2 -> request 16; g5 instances: current 4 -> request 32; ENI quota bump to support 200 concurrent accelerated nodes; vCPU soft limit from 2048 -> 8192.
- 222233334444 (ap-south-1): p4d instances: current 0 -> request 8; g5: 0 -> request 16; ENI request 120; vCPU 4096.

Justification: Redwood Dedicated customer onboarding (low-latency inference), predictable reserved capacity for first 3 months, traffic profile steady at peak 1.2M tokens/day. PM/SE on the account is @olivia, contact olivia@redwood.com.

leo: Do we have AWS support cases opened? Also confirm whether these are org-linked accounts or standalone under tenant org.

maya: They are under our Org (OU: dedicated-tenants). I opened AWS case per region — details below.

sanjay: Created AWS support case 1234569871 (eu-west-4 p5/g5 quota). Case notes: "Reserved inference capacity for production Dedicated pool — request simultaneous increase of ENI and GPUs; provide usage graph and expected instance counts." Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=1234569871

leo: Thanks. AWS asked for projected sustained GPUs per week, AMI/instance family we plan to use, and whether we can tolerate spot v. sustained capacity. Put those numbers in the case.

maya: Projected sustained: eu-west-4 -> 12 p5 equivalents sustained, burst to 16. AMI: redwood-inference-runtime-2026-03 (ami-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h). We'll be using P5d and G5dn families where available.

olivia: FYI finance approved initial committed month spend for both accounts. Need a quick cost estimate breakdown for the commits (per-hour + expected 30d usage).

jordan: Are we also increasing ENI and security-group quotas? Networking is often the blocker for multi-GPU per-host densities.

maya: Yes — request includes ENI increases and increase of max security groups per ENI to 5 for the accounts. We also need higher ephemeral IP quotas to handle node churn.

infra-bot: Track created: INFRA-5472 — multi-account gpu + eni quota work. Assigning to leo.

leo: Small ask: attach Terraform workspace names and the account root emails to the support case. Otherwise AWS won't proceed.

maya: Added workspace names: tf-prod-dedicated-euw4, tf-prod-dedicated-apso1. Root emails masked in case notes.

aws-support: Update: case 1234569871 (eu-west-4) — engineering review started. Expected time to resolution 7-10 business days. Additional info requested: per-AZ distribution and network perf baseline.

sanjay: For ap-south-1 I opened case 1234569902 — AWS requests that we confirm whether P5/G5 families are hardware backed in that region (inventory varies). I'll follow up.

leo: Action items:
- maya: paste usage graphs + per-AZ distribution into AWS cases (due EOD)
- olivia: prepare cost breakdown for committed month
- sanjay: chase ap-south-1 region inventory and update here

maya: On it. I'll attach CloudWatch graphs and a short load profile snippet.

leo: Closing loop for now — eu-west-4 moving through engineering review, ap-south-1 pending inventory check. I'll update thread when quotas are raised or if AWS needs more info. :thumbsup:
